items.html: And the matter is that the lower third rose upward and cleaved and joined with the remainder of the Tifferet of Arich Anpin, as above. And then the two upper joints of the Netzach and Hod of Arich Anpin also rose into the HGT of Aba and Ima, at their chest, and the aspect of breasts was made in them immediately at the beginning of the pregnancy. And by virtue of that ascent, the milk was drawn into the breasts, in order to nurse ZA. And after he was born and the milk was drawn, Arich Anpin expanded downward into its place. Then that lower third of the Tifferet of Arich Anpin became a Neshama for the Hochma of ZA, and then, by the power of that Tifferet, the thirty-two teeth emerged from the thirty-two paths of Hochma.
